title: rosa livescens subsp. trachyphylla
intro: Rosa livescens subsp. trachyphylla, commonly known as Chinese rose or Rosa trachyphylla, is a species of rose native to China and Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its rich content of antioxidants and other bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Rosa trachyphylla include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in promoting wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified to contribute to its medicinal properties.
